title: Marguerite and the Well
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Jude Vasquez, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
